ayahs.textArabic: وَالطُّوْرِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Waṭ-ṭūr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: CONSIDER Mount Sinai!

ayahs.textArabic: وَكِتٰبٍ مَّسْطُوْرٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kitābim masṭūr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Consider [God’s] revelation, inscribed

ayahs.textArabic: فِيْ رَقٍّ مَّنْشُوْرٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fī raqqim mansyūr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: on wide-open scrolls.

ayahs.textArabic: وَّالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُوْرِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-baitil-ma‘mūr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Consider the long-enduring house [of worship]!

ayahs.textArabic: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوْعِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Was-saqfil-marfū‘(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Consider the vault [of heaven] raised high!

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُوْرِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-baḥril-masjūr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Consider the surf-swollen sea!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna ‘ażāba rabbika lawāqi‘(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, [O man,] the suffering decreed by thy Sustainer [for the sinners] will indeed come to pass:

ayahs.textArabic: مَّا لَهٗ مِنْ دَافِعٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā lahū min dāfi‘(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: there is none who could avert it.

ayahs.textArabic: يَّوْمَ تَمُوْرُ السَّمَاۤءُ مَوْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma tamūrus-samā'u maurā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [It will come to pass] on the Day when the skies will be convulsed in [a great] convulsion,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّتَسِيْرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa tasīrul-jibālu sairā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and the mountains will move with [an awesome] movement.

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fawailuy yauma'iżil lil-mukażżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Woe, then, on that Day to all who give the lie to the truth –

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ فِيْ خَوْضٍ يَّلْعَبُوْنَۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna hum fī khauḍiy yal‘abūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: all those who [throughout their lives] but idly played with things vain –

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّوْنَ اِلٰى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma yuda‘‘ūna ilā nāri jahannama da‘‘ā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: on the Day when they shall be thrust into the fire with [an irresistible] thrust, [and will be told:]

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżihin-nārul-latī kuntum bihā tukażżibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “This is the fire which you were wont to call a lie!

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَسِحْرٌ هٰذَآ اَمْ اَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Afasiḥrun hāżā am antum lā tubṣirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Was it, then, a delusion or is it that you failed to see [its truth]?

ayahs.textArabic: اِصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوْٓا اَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوْاۚ سَوَاۤءٌ عَلَيْكُمْۗ  اِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iṣlauhā faṣbirū au lā taṣbirū, sawā'un ‘alaikum, innamā tujzauna mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Endure it [now]! But [whether you] bear yourselves with patience or without patience, it will be the same to you: you are but being requited for what you were wont to do.”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَعِيْمٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-muttaqīna fī jannātiw wa na‘īm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But,] verily, the God-conscious will find themselves [on that Day] in gardens and in bliss,

ayahs.textArabic: فٰكِهِيْنَ بِمَآ اٰتٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْۚ وَوَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum, wa waqāhum rabbuhum ‘ażābal-jaḥīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: rejoicing in all that their Sustainer will have granted them: for their Sustainer will have warded off from them all suffering through the blazing fire.

ayahs.textArabic: كُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا هَنِيْۤـًٔا ۢبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Kulū wasyrabū hanī'am bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And they will be told:] “Eat and drink with good cheer as an outcome of what you were wont to do,

ayahs.textArabic: مُتَّكِـِٕيْنَ عَلٰى سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوْفَةٍۚ وَزَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Muttaki'īna ‘alā sururim maṣfūfah(tin), wa zawwajnāhum biḥūrin ‘īn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: reclining on couches [of happiness] ranged in rows!” And [in that paradise] We shall mate them with companions pure, most beautiful of eye.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِاِيْمَانٍ اَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ اَلَتْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍۗ  كُلُّ امْرِئٍ ۢبِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīna āmanū wattaba‘athum żurriyyatuhum bi'īmānin alḥaqnā bihim żurriyyatahum wa mā alatnāhum min ‘amalihim min syai'(in), kullumri'im bimā kasaba rahīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And as for those who have attained to faith and whose offspring will have followed them in faith, We shall unite them with their offspring; and We shall not let aught of their deeds go to waste: [but] every human being will be held in pledge for whatever he has earned.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمْدَدْنٰهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَّلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa amdadnāhum bifākihatiw wa laḥmim mimmā yasytahūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And We shall bestow on them fruit and meat in abundance - whatever they may desire:

ayahs.textArabic: يَتَنَازَعُوْنَ فِيْهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيْهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Yatanāza‘ūna fīhā ka'sal lā lagwun fīhā wa lā ta'ṡīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and in that [paradise] they shall pass on to one another a cup which will not give rise to empty talk, and neither incite to sin.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَيَطُوْفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَاَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُوْنٌۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaṭūfu ‘alaihim gilmānul lahum ka'annahum lu'lu'um maknūn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they will be waited upon by [immortal] youths, [as if they were children] of their own, [as pure] as if they were pearls hidden in their shells.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ يَّتَسَاۤءَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa aqbala ba‘ḍuhum ‘alā ba‘ḍiy yatasā'alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they [who are thus blest] will turn to one another, asking each other [about their past lives].

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِيْٓ اَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā musyfiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They will say: “Behold, aforetime - when we were [still living] in the midst of our kith and kin - we were full of fear [at the thought of God’s dis­pleasure]:

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقٰىنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa mannallāhu ‘alainā wa waqānā ‘ażābas-samūm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and so God has graced us with His favour, and has warded off from us all suffering through the scorching winds [of frustration].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوْهُۗ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيْمُ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā kunnā min qablu nad‘ūh(u), innahū huwal-barrur-raḥīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, we did invoke Him [alone] ere this: [and now He has shown us] that He alone is truly benign, a true dispenser of grace!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ اَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَّلَا مَجْنُوْنٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa żakkir famā anta bini‘mati rabbika  bikāhiniw wa lā majnūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: EXHORT, then, [O Prophet, all men:] for, by thy Sustainer’s grace, thou art neither a soothsayer nor a madman.

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهٖ رَيْبَ الْمَنُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Am yaqūlūna syā‘irin natarabbaṣu bihī raibal-manūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or do they say, “[He is but] a poet - let us wait what time will do unto him”?

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوْا فَاِنِّيْ مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul tarabbaṣū fa innī ma‘akum minal-mutarabbiṣīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say thou: “Wait, [then,] hopefully; behold, I, too, shall hopefully wait with you!”

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ اَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهٰذَآ اَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Am ta'muruhum aḥlāmuhum bihāżā am hum qaumun ṭāgūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Is it their minds that bid them [to take] this [attitude] - or are they [simply] people filled with overweening arrogance?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ تَقَوَّلَهٗۚ بَلْ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Am yaqūlūna taqawwalah(ū), bal lā yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or do they say, “He himself has composed this [message]”? Nay, but they are not willing to believe!

ayahs.textArabic: فَلْيَأْتُوْا بِحَدِيْثٍ مِّثْلِهٖٓ اِنْ كَانُوْا صٰدِقِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Falya'tū biḥadīṡim  miṡlihī in kānū ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But then, [if they deem it the work of a mere mortal,] let them produce another discourse like it - if what they say be true!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ خُلِقُوْا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ اَمْ هُمُ الْخٰلِقُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am khuliqū min gairi syai'in am humul-khāliqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Or do they deny the existence of God?] Have they themselves been created without anything [that might have caused their creation]? or were they, perchance, their own creators?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَۚ بَلْ لَّا يُوْقِنُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am khalaqus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(a), bal lā yūqinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] have they created the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no certainty of anything!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَاۤىِٕنُ رَبِّكَ اَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَۣيْطِرُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am ‘indahum khazā'inu rabbika  am humul-musaiṭirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [How could they?] Are thy Sustainer’s treasures with them? Or are they in charge [of destiny]?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَّسْتَمِعُوْنَ فِيْهِۚ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am lahum sullamuy yastami‘ūna fīh(i), falya'ti mustami‘uhum bisulṭānim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or have they a ladder by which they could [ascend to ultimate truths and] listen [to what is beyond the reach of human perception]? Let, then, any of them who have listened [to it] produce a manifest proof [of his knowledge]!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ لَهُ الْبَنٰتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am lahul-banātu wa lakumul-banūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or, [if you believe in God, how can you believe that] He has [chosen to have] daughters, whereas you yourselves would have [only] sons?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ اَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim magramim muṡqalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or is it that [they who reject thy message, O Muhammad, fear lest] thou ask of them a reward, so that they would be burdened with debt [if they should listen to thee]?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am ‘indahumul-gaibu fahum yaktubūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or [do they think] that the hidden reality [of all that exists] is almost within their grasp, so that [in time] they can write it down?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ يُرِيْدُوْنَ كَيْدًاۗ فَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا هُمُ الْمَكِيْدُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am yurīdūna kaidā(n), fal-lażīna kafarū humul-makīdūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or do they want to entrap [thee in contradic­tions]? But they who are bent on denying the truth - it is they who are truly entrapped!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ لَهُمْ اِلٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللّٰهِ ۗسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Am lahum ilāhun gairullāh(i), subḥānallāhi ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Have they, then, any deity other than God? Utterly remote is God, in His limitless glory, from anything to which men may ascribe a share in His divinity!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا كِسْفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ سَاقِطًا يَّقُوْلُوْا سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُوْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iy yarau kisfam minas-samā'i sāqiṭay yaqūlū saḥābum markūm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND YET, if they [who refuse to see the truth] were to see part of the sky falling down, they would [only] say, “[It is but] a mass of clouds!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتّٰى يُلٰقُوْا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِيْ فِيْهِ يُصْعَقُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fażarhum ḥattā yulāqū yaumahumul-lażī fīhi yuṣ‘aqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, leave them alone until they face that [Judgment] Day of theirs, when they will be stricken with terror:

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِيْ عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma lā yugnī ‘anhum kaiduhum syai'aw wa lā hum yunṣarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: the Day when none of their scheming will be of the least avail to them, and they will receive no succour.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا عَذَابًا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna lil-lażīna ẓalamū ‘ażāban dūna żālika wa lākinna akṡarahum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But, verily, for those who are bent on doing evil, there is suffering in store [even] closer at hand than that [supreme suffering in the hereafter]: but most of them are not aware of it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِيْنَ تَقُوْمُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Waṣbir liḥukmi rabbika fa innaka bi'a‘yuninā wa sabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, await in patience thy Sustainer’s judgment, for thou art well within Our sight. And extol thy Sustainer’s limitless glory and praise whenever thou risest up,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَاِدْبَارَ النُّجُوْمِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa minal-laili fa sabbiḥhu wa idbāran-nujūm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and extol His glory at night, and at the time when the stars retreat.
